ModMetaData.name: Skylights
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Bring real daylight into a roofed room. Two skylights, powerless and cool, whose light follows the actual sky above — bright at midday, fading through dusk, dark at night, and dimmed by storms and eclipses. Neither works under thick overhead mountain, which seals off the sky.
--- DOME SKYLIGHT --- A small dome-style opening that spreads soft daylight across a radius of about two tiles. Being a small bubble it needs no structural change to the roof and installs fast — a couple of steel and a bit of construction work. It lights a room by natural light but never concentrates enough sun to grow crops. Good for workshops, bedrooms and walkways.
--- PANED SKYLIGHT --- A single glazed square that passes the full strength of the sky straight down onto its own tile — bright enough to grow crops by daylight. Built one tile at a time from a structural frame and a structural glass pane, so a large glass roof is a real construction project.
--- THE SUPPLY CHAIN --- Structural frames and structural glass are both fabricated at an electric smelter: Structural frames - one steel makes four frames. Structural glass - one steel makes one pane. Each is available as a single batch or a discounted bulk batch.
--- VS. THE SUN LAMP --- An honest trade: skylights are free and never overheat a room, but they are only as bright as the day outside and go dark every night. Research Skylights to unlock both, plus the smelter recipes.
Safe to add or remove mid-save.
